item.title: Portugal rebukes NATO chief Rutte over 'flippant' missile remarks
item.description: The foreign ministry in Lisbon objected to remarks suggesting the government downplays the Russian threat, as Spain stayed silent.

item.title: Karasin says no agreement exists for Europeans to join the Abu Dhabi talks
item.description: Karasin called French plans of attendance wishful thinking, while Kallas says any agreement the EU is not party to will not be implemented. Costa has put EU participation on the agenda of Friday's informal leaders' meeting in Dublin.

item.title: At least 20 dead in two boats off Crete as minister plans EU return hub initiative
item.description: The Greek coastguard rescued 46 survivors from two boats south of Kali Limenes, and Frontex teams picked up about 87 more on Monday. Deputy Migration Minister Sevi Voloudaki says the migration minister will present an initiative with other member states within days.

item.title: Ten northern countries sign naval partnership pact led from Britain's Northwood
item.description: Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Norway, Sweden and the United Kingdom sign the agreement, which keeps the forces under national authority. The United States is not part of it.

item.title: Seven parliaments legislating is not fragmentation. It is consent
item.description: Brussels wants one rulebook for addictive design, replacing laws that seven nations are already passing. A floor of minimum harmonisation we could accept. A regulation that wipes national law hands power to an institution no European voter can remove.

item.title: American law binds no president. National law must bind Europe's defence.
item.description: An 86-vote sanctions act sat unused after an October waiver, and 400 million dollars authorized by Congress was delayed. A Congress that can be read around is not a guarantee; only national statutes are.

item.title: Germany runs two exercises in Lithuania under new defence declaration
item.description: More than 6,000 soldiers of the 10th Panzer Division take part from 6 November to 3 December, days after Kaunas and Pistorius signed a cooperation pact in Munich on 4 November.

item.title: Darmanin says Le Pen or Mélenchon as president would end Europe as it exists
item.description: The French justice minister made the claim at a Barcelona forum, backing Édouard Philippe for 2027 and calling for a pro-European candidate who would turn Europe into one of power rather than discussion.

item.title: Brussels investigated for two years. Kathmann's parliament acted in two days.
item.description: Consumer law is the one power the treaties left fully in national hands, and eight parliaments are right to use it while the Commission's cases sit unresolved. National rules should be a floor Brussels must match, not an obstacle it must erase.
